lessons.description: Seven to ten questions on freelancing and career, with an answer key.
lessons.content:
<!-- scaffold -->

> Scaffold. One sample question is written so the format is clear; the remaining
> questions are not written yet.

## Practice questions

Seven to ten questions covering everything in Freelancing & Digital Marketing Career, each with an answer key
that explains why the right answer is right.

:::quiz
Q. Why does a portfolio usually matter more than a certificate when pitching a first client?
+ It shows work the client can judge, rather than a claim they have to trust
- Certificates are worthless
- Clients never ask about training
= Evidence of doing the work is the strongest early signal. A certificate supports it; it does not replace it.
:::

## Where to look if you got one wrong

A pointer back to the lesson each question came from.

lessons.description: Produce a portfolio, proposal and rate card, marked out of 100.
lessons.content:
<!-- scaffold -->

> Scaffold. The structure, title and position of this lesson are final; the body

## The brief

A portfolio, proposal and rate card. What is being asked for, and the constraints it has to work inside.

## What to submit

The file, the format and anything that must be shown alongside it.

:::template Submission cover sheet
Name:
Brand:
Module: Freelancing & Digital Marketing Career
Deliverable:
Time spent:
What I would do differently with more budget:
:::

## Marking rubric

Marked out of 100. The bands below are placeholders until the assignment is written.

- Research and understanding of the audience — 20 marks
- Correct use of the method taught in this module — 30 marks
- Quality and realism of the deliverable — 30 marks
- Clarity of presentation and reasoning — 20 marks

A pass is 50. Anything that invents data about a real company scores zero on realism.
